title: MBBM Stock Solutions Preparation
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.hgtb3wn
materials: Autoclave all stock solutions at 121ºC for 20 min except solution #8 and #10 (stir to dissolve)

steps.title: Prepare NaNO3 Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Add 25.0 g NaNO3 per liter d-H2O.

steps.title: Prepare CaCl2 Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 g CaCl2 *2H2O per liter d-H2O.

steps.title: Prepare MgSO4 Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 g MgSO4 *7H2O per liter d-H2O.

steps.title: Prepare K2HPO4 Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 g K2HPO4 per liter d-H2O.

steps.title: Prepare KH2PO4 Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Add 17.5 g KH2PO4 per liter d-H2O.

steps.title: Prepare NaCl Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 g NaCl per liter d-H2O.

steps.title: Prepare EDTA and KOH Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Add 50.0 g disodium EDTA and 31.0 g KOH per liter d-H2O.

steps.title: Prepare FeSO4 Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Add 4.98 g FeSO4 *7H2O per liter acidified H2O.

substeps.instruction: Prepare acidified H2O by mixing 999.0 mL d-H2O and 1.0 mL concentrated H2SO4

steps.title: Prepare H3BO3 Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Add 11.42 g H3BO3 per liter d-H2O.
